mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Financial institution of the beneficial owner

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK HMT sanctions list, and the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit's domestic PEP list before commencing any client relationship. Enhanced due diligence required for PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, and where the business model indicates higher money laundering or terrorist financing risk. Ongoing transaction monitoring and periodic review on a risk-based approach in accordance with the AML/CFT Act 2012.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Corporate Registry (Registrar of Corporations, e-Filing via licensed Registered Agents)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Latin script; English and Marshallese are the recognized languages for registered names. Names in other scripts must be transliterated into Latin characters. Arabic numerals may be used. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name, and must not imply a prohibited purpose or association with a government entity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be requested through a licensed Registered Agent. If rejected, the applicant has 14 days to file a written appeal with the Registrar of Corporations, stating legal and factual grounds. The Registrar must respond within 14 working days. A rejected name may be re-submitted once after modification. If still rejected, a further appeal can be filed with the High Court of the Marshall Islands within 30 days. A name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30 days upon written request before expiry, at the Registrar's discretion.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for administrative and registered-address purposes, provided a Marshall Islands Registered Agent maintains a physical street address. No physical operating office in the Marshall Islands is required for this industry, and no statutory requirement for local employees.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated <10% annual probability); authorities may conduct on-site inspection if suspicious activity or AML/CFT complaints arise.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990 (Title 51, Marshall Islands Revised Code), as amended; key sections: BCA §24 (incorporators), §28 (Articles of Incorporation), §33 (registered office and resident agent), §35 (directors), §40 (share issuance consideration), §50 (organizational meeting).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro); filings are transmitted through registered agents accredited by the Marshall Islands Corporate Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement; the Corporation may commence business with nominal authorized capital (e.g., USD 1,000), and shares may be issued for cash or any lawful consideration approved by the Board.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accepts the subscription for one thousand (1,000) common shares at US$1.00 per share from the subscribing founder, and the Secretary is directed to issue the corresponding share certificate upon full payment. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation shall be located at the resident agent's address in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and such resident agent is ratified as the statutory agent for service of process. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the President, Secretary, and Treasurer are appointed as officers, each to serve until the next annual stockholders' meeting, with full authority to open bank and merchant payment accounts, execute commercial contracts, and take all lawful actions to commence business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General (via accredited agent portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request for the proposed corporate name, which must end with 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited' or an approved abbreviation. The Registrar searches the corporate index for conflict or deceptive similarity; on approval, the name is reserved for 90 days. Filing is effected exclusively through an accredited Marshall Islands registered agent.
required_dossiers: Identity of proposed incorporator (passport copy for natural person or certificate of good standing for corporate incorporator)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused on grounds of conflict or deceptiveness, submit up to two alternate names with the same request; no additional government fee applies for alternate names within the initial filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation (Form BCA-1)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator (founder) assisted by an accredited registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation setting forth the corporate name, registered agent, registered office in the Marshall Islands, authorized share capital, purpose clause (including precision CO2 laser cutting, assembly and sale of 3D wooden mechanical puzzles), and the number of directors. The incorporator signs the Articles; the signature is notarized or acknowledged, and the instrument is transmitted to the registered agent for filing.
required_dossiers: Consent of resident agent to act as statutory agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries a defective purpose clause or capital description, file corrected Articles with a re-executed signature page and pay the standard processing fee; the original filing date is preserved where the correction is submitted within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles of Incorporation and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the executed Articles together with the government filing fee and the resident agent consent. Upon statutory review, the Registrar endorses the Articles and issues the Certificate of Incorporation, which constitutes conclusive evidence of the legal existence of the Business Corporation.
required_dossiers: Executed and notarized Articles of Incorporation (Form BCA-1)
Written consent and appointment of resident agent
Cover letter from accredited registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a notice of non-compliance (e.g., incomplete agent consent), the agent has 15 days under BCA §31 to cure by filing a corrective statement; failure to cure renders the filing ineffective and a new filing fee would apply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting and Adoption of First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and subscribers (organizational action under BCA §50)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator or the named directors hold an organizational meeting in person, by telephone, or by unanimous written consent. The Board adopts the by-laws, accepts the share subscription, ratifies the registered office and resident agent, and elects the President, Secretary and Treasurer. The minutes or written consent are recorded in the corporate records book.
required_dossiers: Notice of organizational meeting or unanimous written consent
First board resolution as set out above
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any officer or director declines appointment, the Board may immediately fill the vacancy by written resolution; no filing with the Registrar is required for internal officer changes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Kit Assembly and Post-Incorporation Confirmations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Accredited registered agent and corporate secretarial provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent assembles the corporate kit containing the Certificate of Incorporation, by-laws, board minutes, share certificates, corporate seal and registered office confirmation. The provider performs a post-incorporation verification against the Registrar's index, obtains a Certificate of Good Standing, and opens the ongoing compliance file for annual franchise tax reporting.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued by the Registrar)
Registered office and resident agent confirmation letter
Request for Certificate of Good Standing (for banks or payment processors)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Good Standing contains errors, apply for a corrected certificate within 5 business days; the correction is issued without additional fee where the error is attributable to the Registry.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Resources and Development, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Manufacturing and Trade Division); no industrial license is mandatory for a non-resident offshore entity without physical operations in the jurisdiction.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License (Non-Resident Domestic Corporation) — not required where no physical place of business is maintained in the Marshall Islands; a General or Wholesale License would become due only upon local import, export, or retail dealing.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA), Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt for offshore non-resident operations; Registration/Category 3 EIA would apply only if CO2 laser cutting and puzzle assembly facilities are physically established in the RMI, pursuant to the Environmental Protection Act 1984.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: If local operations commence: compliance with EPA ambient standards and WHO guidelines — wastewater BOD ≤ 30 mg/L and TSS ≤ 50 mg/L before discharge; airborne particulate (PM10) 24-hour mean ≤ 150 µg/m³; laser fume extraction with volatile organic compound (VOC) controls; and segregated disposal of charred wood dust and laser off-cuts under the EPA Waste Management Regulations 1990.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to a non-resident offshore entity with no physical premises. If a local production unit is established: Fire Safety Certificate per NFPA 101 (Life Safety Code) issued by the Majuro Fire Marshal, structural load inspection by the local Building Inspector, and an Occupational Clearance under RMI Workplace Health and Safety Standards, including Class-4 laser enclosure, fume extraction, and eye-protection controls.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI); official government portal: https://rmi.gov.mh (no dedicated tax e-filing portal; filings are accepted in paper form at the Majuro office)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation (BC) incorporated under the Business Corporations Act has no obligation to obtain a domestic income tax TIN because it derives no income from RMI sources and is expressly exempt from RMI income tax. If the BC nevertheless requires an identification number for banking or customs purposes, it must obtain a certificate of good standing from the Registrar of Corporations. If, in a non-default scenario, the BC engages in any business activity within the geographical limits of the RMI, it must register with the Revenue and Taxation Division on Form R&T-1 within 30 days of commencement, file a Business License application, and obtain a TIN. Foreign entities with no RMI physical presence or RMI-source income complete only the corporate registration; no income tax registration is triggered.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The RMI has no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election system. Under Section 51 of the Business Corporations Act, a BC designated as 'non-resident' is wholly exempt from RMI income tax on all income derived outside the RMI. A BC that carries on business in the RMI may elect or be classified as a 'resident' corporation, becoming subject to the Marshalls Income Tax Act only on RMI-source income; no further elective classifications, tax-transparent pass-through regimes, or hybrid instrument elections are available under RMI law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST/Sales and Use Tax; indirect taxation limited to customs import duty and excise under the Customs Act 2000 and applicable tariff regulations
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - the RMI levies no VAT, GST, or general sales tax, and there is no turnover-based indirect tax registration threshold. A customs registration (ASYCUDA World importer/exporter code) is required solely for the operational clearance of goods at the border, with no minimum economic threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing, or digital stamping mandate exists. The RMI Customs Service utilises ASYCUDA World for electronic processing of export and import declarations; commercial invoices are accepted in PDF/paper form and do not require tax authority pre-approval. There is no government API clearance mandate applicable to private-issued invoices, and no continuous transaction control (CTC) regime.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable in the strict VAT sense, as the RMI does not impose a value-added tax. All goods exported from the RMI are outside the indirect tax net: customs duty is chargeable on importation only, and no export duty is assessed. A non-resident Business Corporation deriving income exclusively from offshore sales of precision CO2 laser-cut wooden puzzles is likewise outside the RMI income tax net. To establish zero RMI tax exposure, the BC should evidence that (i) goods are shipped to an address outside the RMI, (ii) title transfers abroad, and (iii) no RMI-source services are rendered.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration processed through ASYCUDA World
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export from the RMI
Commercial Invoice and detailed packing list
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank receipt of export proceeds (where required to evidence offshore receipt; RMI generally imposes no exchange controls)
Certificate of Origin (only if claiming preferential tariff treatment under a trade agreement)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There is no VAT or indirect tax refund mechanism to claw back, because no such tax is levied. However, false export declarations, undervaluation, misdescription of goods, or the diversion of goods to the domestic market are prosecutable under Part XI of the Customs Act 2000 and the RMI Criminal Code. Penalties include fines up to USD 500,000 per offence, imprisonment, forfeiture of goods and conveyances, and retrospective reassessment of any import duties circumvented. If a BC mischaracterises RMI-source gross revenue as offshore export income to escape the Marshalls Income Tax Act, the Revenue and Taxation Division may assert tax on the challenged amount plus a penalty of up to 50% of the underpaid tax and statutory interest, determined on audit under the audit powers of the Income Tax Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) maintains no domestic central bank; the United States Dollar is the sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association. Banking and money-services regulation is administered by the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, pursuant to the Financial Institutions Act 2015 (as amended), with AML/CFT oversight shared by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit. The de facto monetary authority for USD issuance and monetary policy is the United States Federal Reserve System.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full current-account and capital-account convertibility with zero statutory exchange-control restrictions. USD legal-tender status eliminates domestic convertibility risk; there are no RMI exchange-control regulations, no capital-repatriation ceilings, and no withholding tax on dividends or profit remittances payable to non-resident shareholders. Dividend distributions require only a valid board resolution, updated share register, and confirmation from the RMI Treasury of the entity's non-resident tax-exempt status.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. RMI imposes no statutory timeline for surrender of export proceeds, no mandatory conversion ratios, and no requirement to repatriate or hold foreign-currency earnings onshore. USD export receipts for the laser-assembled wooden puzzle products clear directly through the domestic banking system without conversion or regulatory approval.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (for inbound equity injection) and Operational USD Current Account (for Amazon Pay/Stripe settlement sweeps and trade disbursements)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam, Majuro Branch (FDIC-insured U.S. depository)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Account and Treasury Clearing Account leveraging U.S. Fedwire/CHIPS correspondent network

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, Revolut Business) are not licensed in the RMI and generally decline RMI-registered corporate entities due to jurisdictional AML risk policies; RMI legislation provides no EMI licensing track under the Financial Institutions Act 2015. The experimental SOV digital-currency project does not constitute a banking or EMI onboarding rail. Amazon Pay and Stripe function solely as upstream marketplace settlement rails that remit net USD proceeds to the RMI bank account, not as substitute bank accounts.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person appearance or appearance before a licensed notary public/RMI Registered Agent is mandatory for the authorized signatories and the ultimate beneficial owner; fully remote online-only account opening is not available for non-resident corporations. BOMI generally requires a board-level interview (in-person or at the bank's discretion via secure video with pre-notarized identification), while Bank of Guam additionally requires physical identity verification at its Majuro branch or by a local authorized representative. Apostilled corporate documents and original passport inspection are standard prerequisites.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore-registered entity with no local physical presence and 100% foreign beneficial ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Good Standing from the RMI Registrar of Corporations; apostilled Certificate of Incorporation and By-Laws; Register of Beneficial Owners filed under the Business Corporations Act; board resolution nominating authorized signatories; RMI Treasury tax-status letter confirming non-resident BC exemption; annual economic-substance declaration evidencing that no RMI-territory business activity is conducted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through funding or opaque source of shareholder capital
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds letter from the originating bank covering at least six months of transaction history; notarized personal net-worth statement of the UBO; independent AML search waiver; precise capital-injection schedule tied to the ISIC-3240 working-capital plan; copies of the shareholder loan or subscription agreement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discrepancy between the RMI registration address and the actual production footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Manufacturing and assembly subcontract or tolling agreement naming the operating facility and the CO2 laser equipment; purchase invoices for basswood sheets, laser tubes, lenses, and mechanical motion kits; Amazon Marketplace business-verification snapshot; Stripe settlement ledger; product photos and bill-of-materials for the 3D mechanical wooden puzzle product line.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity and shareholder-loan capital is routed via SWIFT MT103 (or Fedwire for U.S. originating banks) to the BOMI USD operational account in the exact registered name of the entity (MH_BC). The remittance purpose code shall be recorded as 'Equity Participation' or 'Shareholder Loan – Capital Injection', with MT103 field 70 referencing the corporate resolution date and subscription agreement; the recipient bank must hold pre-filed beneficial-ownership documentation to avoid U.S. correspondent screening delays. No RMI exchange-control approval is required, but the beneficiary legal name, account number, and UBO identity must match the KYC file exactly.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier payments for production inputs (basswood, CO2 laser tubes, mirrors, lenses, gear kits, packaging) are settled by SWIFT MT103 directly to the vendor's account, with field 70 citing the commercial invoice and purchase order; bulk procurements exceeding USD 50,000 are executed through a Commercial Letter of Credit issued by BOMI (deferred-sight tenor of 30-90 days). All USD clearing runs via the U.S. correspondent network over Fedwire/CHIPS, and daily net proceeds from Amazon Pay and Stripe marketplace accounts are swept into the BOMI operational account as the designated concentration account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, AUD/USD) on a plain-vanilla OTC basis executed through BOMI or its U.S. correspondent bank
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) quoted by U.S. bank treasury desks for illiquid exotic currency pairs arising from marketplace receivables
Cross-Currency Swaps (USD base) converting multi-currency Amazon Pay and Stripe settlement balances into USD on a deterministic schedule
FX Options (European-style plain vanilla puts/calls) limited to hedge-only transactions covering confirmed purchase orders and receivables

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of the Business Corporation (annual government renewal and corporate status declaration listing registered agent, registered office, directors and officers; base government fee US$200 where authorized capital does not exceed US$10,000, US$400 where it exceeds US$10,000; no separate income-tax return exists for a non-resident tax-exempt entity).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands, filed through the licensed Marshall Islands registered agent's electronic portal.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: due on or before the last day of the calendar month in which the incorporation anniversary falls, recurring every 12 months.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A surcharge of 10% of the unpaid annual fee is added per month (or part of a month) of default, capped at 100% of the annual fee; failure to file for three consecutive years empowers the Registrar to administratively dissolve or strike off the corporation without court proceedings, restoration requiring a court application, payment of all arrears, and reinstatement costs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance Notification (nil or exemption confirmation: ISIC 3240 wooden-puzzle laser cutting and assembly is not a scheduled relevant activity under the Economic Substance Regulations).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Economic Substance Unit, submitted through the registered agent as part of the joint annual compliance filing.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fiscal-period rule: file within 12 months after the end of the financial year; for a 31 December year-end the latest date is 31 December of the following year, with the Anniversary-month deadline of the Annual Report serving as the practical submission target.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Defaulting entities and responsible officers may incur administrative fines of up to US$10,000, plus continuing daily penalties while the notification remains outstanding; persistent non-compliance may lead to strike-off or dissolution and disqualification of directors.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit attaches to this private, non-resident, tax-exempt Business Corporation; the BCA imposes no revenue, asset, or headcount thresholds. An independent audit becomes mandatory only if the corporation becomes a listed or exchange-traded issuer, if the Registrar or a competent court so orders, if the articles of incorporation, by-laws, or shareholders' agreement require it, or if commercial conditions such as bank finance or payment-processor due diligence contractually impose an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Books and records may be maintained under IFRS or US GAAP in USD; the BCA requires only that records be complete, correct, and sufficient to explain transactions and enable the financial position to be assessed with reasonable accuracy.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Marshall Islands uses a confidential (closed) beneficial-ownership model: there is no public UBO register, but the corporation must maintain an internal Beneficial Ownership Register and transmit a Beneficial Ownership Annual Confirmation to the Registrar in conjunction with the Annual Report. Any share transfer or change in a person ultimately owning 25% or more of the issued shares, and any change of director or officer, must be entered in the statutory registers and notified through the registered agent within 30 days of the event; the Register of Members must be updated contemporaneously with each share transfer to preserve prima facie title evidence.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (share ledger, transfers, and pledges)
Minute Book (members' and directors' minutes and written resolutions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 900 – USD 1,700 per annum for licensed registered agent, registered office, and preparation and filing of the Annual Report, UBO confirmation, and Economic Substance Notification.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (no statutory audit applies); where a voluntary certified audit is later required for financing, due diligence, or payment-processor compliance, the market range for this small manufacturer is approximately USD 5,000 – USD 12,000 per engagement.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% effective for the non-resident Business Corporation with no RMI-source income. The Income Tax Act 1989 nominally imposes a flat 31% corporate rate, but solely on income derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands; all foreign-source manufacturing, e-commerce, and IP income of this BC is outside the RMI tax net.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No tax holiday regime exists because the exemption is structural. The RMI levies no income tax on foreign-source income, no capital gains tax, no estate tax, no VAT/GST, and no payroll tax on non-resident personnel of this structure. The only recurring statutory impost is the annual corporate report fee payable to the Registrar of Corporations, computed on authorized share capital.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Report (Business Corporations Act 1990) — required filing for every Business Corporation; prepared and e-filed by the licensed RMI registered agent through the Office of the Registrar of Corporations (Majuro) service-agent portal; no direct public e-portal for non-resident principals.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within the anniversary month of incorporation each year; failure to file within the grace period triggers late penalties and potential strike-off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact corporate name, registration number, registered agent name, and registered office address in the RMI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the data from the Certificate of Incorporation; the registered agent is the sole correspondence point for the Registrar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names and usual residential addresses of all directors and officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident natural persons are permitted; no RMI residency, work permit, or local employment is required for a non-resident BC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares, par value, and issued share capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The annual government fee is calculated on this sliding-scale declaration; maintain consistency with incorporation records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Brief description of the company's actual business activity during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'Online sale of precision laser-cut wooden puzzles and educational hobby toys'; confirm no operations, employees, property, or revenue sourced within the RMI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration whether the company derived any income from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If 'none', no RMI income tax return is required and the annual report exhausts all RMI filing obligations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs a monthly surcharge of 10% of the government annual fee (or part month) up to the Registrar's prescribed cap; continued default permits administrative strike-off and dissolution, cancellation of good-standing certificates, and freeze of the corporate bank and payment-rail relationships.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Income Tax Return for Corporations (Income Tax Act 1989, Ministry of Finance and Taxation, Tax and Revenue Division) — triggered exclusively by the derivation of RMI-source income; not applicable to the contemplated non-resident structure.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Not applicable for a non-resident BC with zero RMI-source income; if such income were to arise, the return and payment are due by the statutory deadline after the close of the taxable year (calendar-year default).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RMI tax identification number and taxable year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply for a TIN only if an RMI filing obligation is triggered; otherwise no TIN registration is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All income derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporations report only RMI-source income; Chinese manufacturing profit and US marketplace sales are excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ordinary and necessary expenses attributable to RMI-source income and available credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions must be factually connected to RMI-source income; minimal for the described activity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No filing is required for the described activity. If triggered and omitted, the Income Tax Act imposes monetary penalties, interest on unpaid tax, and criminal sanctions for willful evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the RMI imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by a Business Corporation to non-resident shareholders; distributions are effected by board resolution and bank instruction without any RMI governmental approval or filing.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreement network, so no DTA relief mechanism, tax-residence certificate, or treaty-benefit submission exists for outbound distributions. Repatriation is documented by board minutes, a dividend declaration, and the remittance instruction; the shareholder must separately assess residence-jurisdiction tax, including US Subpart F/GILTI if the RMI BC is a controlled foreign corporation owned by US persons.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and 0% treaty rate — the RMI has no outbound withholding tax on IP royalties or debt interest paid by a BC to non-residents. Caution: if the RMI entity licenses IP to a Chinese manufacturing affiliate, China-source licence fees paid to the RMI entity are subject to Chinese withholding (10% statutory; no RMI-China treaty reduction) and the royalty must be priced at arm's length.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — the RMI has no domestic transfer-pricing statute, no Local File/Master File thresholds, no country-by-country reporting notification for a non-resident BC, and no USD-denominated documentation triggers. Counterparty tax administrations (China, US, EU) may independently impose TP documentation and proof-of-substance obligations on transactions with this entity.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI does not operate BVI/Cayman-style Economic Substance Regulations for a standard non-resident BC. However, the RMI participates in the OECD Inclusive Framework and the EU fair-taxation screening, under which a zero-tax entity must demonstrate genuine economic substance in its claimed jurisdiction of management. For this structure, retained substance markers should include: a physical management office in the operating jurisdiction, employee and payroll records, board minutes authorizing the Amazon Pay and Stripe accounts, an executed laser-cutting and assembly subcontract with the Chinese factory, and an independent commercial decision trail. A bare shell with no substance anywhere invites IRS re-characterization (US trade or business via FBA inventory; Form 1120-F exposure) or Chinese SAT place-of-effective-management assertions (25% CIT and 10% dividend WHT).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion — deliberate under-declaration of RMI-source income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsely certifying in the annual report that no income is RMI-source while operating a physical retail or warehouse function in Majuro or Ebeye, or knowingly submitting false declarations to the Registrar of Corporations to avoid RMI income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Income Tax Act 1989, willful attempted evasion of tax is a felony punishable by a fine of up to USD 10,000, imprisonment of up to 2 years, or both, together with interest and civil penalties on the understated tax; the Registrar may additionally revoke the company's good-standing certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations are subject to criminal prosecution, imprisonment, and criminal fines; the corporate veil is pierced for the fraudulent filings, exposing personal assets to the RMI tax authority, the Registrar, and civil restitution claims.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / extraterritorial economic substance failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the Amazon FBA business as a pure conduit: no office, no employees, no board meetings, no commercial decision trail; management exercised from Shenzhen or Shanghai; US inventory held in Amazon fulfillment centers attributed to the RMI entity with US-marketplace sales.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: US exposure: the IRS may assert that the RMI entity is engaged in a US trade or business through FBA inventory, taxing effectively connected income at 21% via Form 1120-F, imposing the 30% branch profits tax, accuracy penalties under IRC §6662 (20%-40%), and a 75% civil fraud penalty. China exposure: place-of-effective-management re-characterization exposes the Chinese manufacturing profit to 25% CIT and 10% dividend withholding on distributions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors controlling funds may face the US trust-fund recovery penalty (IRC §6672) equal to 100% of unpaid withheld amounts; travel bans and extradition may be sought in tax-fraud proceedings; directors face personal civil restitution in US state and federal actions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using nominee directors or bearer-like share constructs to conceal the US or Chinese ultimate beneficial owner; failure to maintain the beneficial-ownership records required by the RMI registered-agent due-diligence regime; routing payments through Stripe or Amazon Pay to sanctioned counterparties or high-risk jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI AML/CFT supervision through the Financial Intelligence Unit authorizes administrative fines, deregistration of the company, and referral for criminal prosecution; payment processors (Stripe, Amazon Pay) and correspondent banks may freeze balances, terminate accounts, and file SARs, triggering global de-risking.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers face criminal prosecution for money-laundering offenses, asset freezing and confiscation orders, imprisonment, and permanent exclusion from international banking; directors may be held personally liable for civil restitution of laundered proceeds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the annual corporate report and pay the Registrar's annual fee for multiple consecutive years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Registrar strikes off and dissolves the company; it loses legal capacity to sue or defend, the Amazon seller account and Stripe balance are frozen, and the corporate bank account is blocked; restoration requires court proceedings plus payment of all arrears, surcharges, and reinstatement fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors incurring obligations after dissolution are jointly and severally liable for the company's debts; post-dissolution contracts bind the directors personally, and the corporate veil cannot be invoked to shield them from creditor claims.
